name: Health Screening Schedule
description: Provides age-based and sex-based preventive health screening frameworks derived from major medical guideline structures. Produces a screening timeline organized by life stage with screening types, general frequency guidelines, and questions to discuss with a healthcare provider. Use when the user asks about recommended health screenings by age, when to get certain check-ups, or how to build a preventive screening schedule. Do NOT use for interpreting screening results, recommending specific tests for individuals, or making scheduling decisions for users with existing health conditions.
